message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules** | Item | Description | |------|-------------| | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each except one 0) and two of each action card: Skip, Reverse, Draw Two. 4 Wild cards and 4 Wild Draw Four cards. | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are tallied after each round when a player goes “Uno” (has one card left) or wins a round (no cards left). | | **Setup** | • Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining deck face down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately. | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a Reverse card changes direction). | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play one card that matches either the **color**, **number**, or **symbol** of the top discard.
• **Wild** cards can be played at any time; you must declare the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** can only be played if you have no other playable card (see challenge rule). | | **If You Can’t Play** | Draw one card from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – next player draws four cards, you choose the new color. | | **Winning a Round** | When a player discards their last card, the round ends. The winner scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards remaining in opponents’ hands: number cards = face value, action cards = 20, wild cards = 50. | | **Going “Uno”** | When you have one card left, you must say “Uno!” before the next player takes their turn. If you fail and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Challenge Wild Draw Four** | If you suspect the previous player used a Wild Draw Four illegally (i.e., they had a playable card), you may challenge.
• If the challenger is correct, the previous player draws four cards.
• If the challenger is wrong, the challenger draws six cards. | | **End of Game** | The first player to reach the target score (usually 500) wins. If you’re playing a shorter game, set a lower target or play a single round. | --- ### Quick‑Start Summary 1. **Deal** 7 cards each. 2. **Flip** top card to start discard pile. 3. **Play** a matching card or draw. 4. **Use** action cards to affect opponents. 5. **Say** “Uno” when you’re down to one card. 6. **Score** when someone goes out. 7. **Repeat** until someone reaches the target score. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
